$comment: Declared open gaps: failures this suite is EXPECTED to produce, because the honest state of the corpus is that they are open. A run passes IF AND ONLY IF the observed failure set equals this set EXACTLY. Not 'at least these'. A MISSING expected failure is as much a finding as an unexpected one — it means a gap closed silently or a check stopped running. Adding an entry here is a decision to ship a known gap; it is never a way to quiet a failure.

gaps.why: units-unknown-state is estate-wide and the per-unit states it derives from are absent from the contract, so 2.2's third arm cannot evaluate for any value.
gaps.closedBy: Version B — carry the dedup RESOLUTION parameter and a per-unit state set. Product decision first.

gaps.why: Same figure, same absent inputs, in the second overview fixture.
